items.caption: 走 in a modern rendering of the Shuowen seal-script form. This form reflects the received account of 走 as composed of 夭 and 止, while later paleographic analysis interprets the upper shape as a running person.
items.alt: A bold black seal-script character with a tall, curved upper stroke and broad sweeping middle and lower strokes on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The visible seal-script form illustrates the tradition preserved by Shuowen and helps distinguish that historical analysis from the modern interpretation of earlier forms as a running person. It does not establish the character’s earliest structure.

limitations.text: This seal-script rendering illustrates the received Shuowen tradition, not the oldest form. Interpretations of the earliest graph differ, and no direct oracle-bone glyph image is included here.
